sources.excerpt: Honey Bee Overdrive Plus by BearFoot FX | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE BearFoot FX Honey Bee Overdrive Plus LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS OVERDRIVE EQUALIZER BOOSTER Description The Bearfoot FX Honey Bee OD is a highly-regarded overdrive pedal known for its unique tone-shaping capabilities. It features an upper-mid and treble Preamp booster knob, allowing for precise adjustments to its EQ character. This pedal also includes controls for Volume, Drive, and “Nature” (Bass), providing a wide range of tonal possibilities.
